findings.message: The diff implements the approved LLD (chosen alt a1) faithfully: the menu icon is set via IconLoader on pluginIcon.svg (ShowOrRegisterRepoAction), and RepoStatusDialog's Loaded render is reworked into accordion collapsiblePanel groups (Repository / Files-by-language / Entities-by-kind) with content-sized JTables inside ONE outer JBScrollPane(AS_NEEDED/NEVER) over the new width-tracking ScrollableColumn, while preserving the off-EDT read + !disposed guard + Unavailable-as-plain-message. The shared InsrcCollapsible helper is new (settings page untouched). No adherence breach.

Follows the established plugin idioms: the accordion + Scrollable-column + content-sized-JTable (tableHeader NORTH + table CENTER, no inner scroll pane) mirror InsrcSettingsConfigurable's bodyFor/collapsiblePanel/ScrollableContentPanel verbatim; JBUI.scale for all sizes; off-EDT read via executeOnPooledThread + invokeLater(ModalityState.any()) guarded on @Volatile disposed. No convention breach in the diff.

GROUNDING LIMITATION (reported honestly): the daemon grounding is again file-level diff-only over the 2 git-TRACKED changed files (Kotlin is not symbol-indexed; the NEW ui/InsrcCollapsible.kt helper + the new RepoStatusPopupLayoutTest.kt are UNTRACKED and absent from the diff). Coverage was verified locally instead: the full gradlew test suite is green (47/47 test classes, 0 failures) INCLUDING the new RepoStatusPopupLayoutTest (ac1 icon; ac2 accordion+tables not flat rows; ac3 one outer AS_NEEDED/NEVER JBScrollPane + ScrollableColumn tracksHeight=false + viewport-independent preferred size; ac4 off-EDT preserved + settings page unmodified). Not a code defect — an automated-grounding limitation.

Correctness verified: the fixed-size + scroll mechanic reproduces the hardened settings-page fix (ScrollableColumn tracksViewportHeight=ALWAYS false + a viewport-independent bounded preferred size, now floored at a CONSTANT JBUI.scale(480) min width via coerceAtLeast — no width-feedback spiral); the value column gets a tooltip renderer (leak-free flyweight idiom) so long path/error values are fully readable; empty maps render a '(none)' row; the icon load is safe (blank on missing resource, never throws). An opposite-actor cold review (author != reviewer) traced the layout + threading against the settings-page mechanic and returned SHIP (0/0/0) after a MED born-too-narrow popup was fixed. No outstanding quality risk.
